answer: Require every new identity to lock a refundable bond and earn verification work only through attestations from already-trusted peers. Trust spreads like a vine: each vertex in the attestation graph gains weight only from several independent paths, never from a single cluster. A sybil farm must therefore fund thousands of bonds and wait out months of honest work, so the cost of faking a crowd rises faster than the tide of fake accounts, while one honest agent pays almost nothing to join.
